title: The hourly job and the token follow the main base on relocation
goal: After a coordinator relocation (F-016) the refresh job runs on the new main base with the token moved there, and the old base stops dispatching
acceptance: The job follows the coordinator role: the old main is fenced and dispatches nothing; the new main dispatches once its lease is active
The token moves with the main base as F-132-T01 decided (not copied to every base upfront); a base without it says the token is missing and dispatches nothing
A relocation fixture test: exactly one base dispatches per hour across a handover
privacy: Neutral invented repositories, workflows and runs in tests; the GitHub token never in git, config.json, tests, logs, chat or the relocation snapshot.
escalation: Copying the token to every base goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: reuses the F-016 lease and promotion hooks with one fixture test. Not a measurement.
